## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and acceptance criteria.

Name the owning team/phase, acceptance matrix IDs, accepted contract revision, and prerequisite issues or artifacts. Use a `design/`, `engineer/`, or `qa/` branch as specified in CONTRIBUTING.md.

## Verification

List commands/results and any browser or development deployment evidence. State what was not tested.

Identify the candidate SHA, configuration/seed, environment, and affected shared gate. Link Design/QA review where applicable and distinguish planned checks from passing evidence.

## Operations

Describe configuration, protocol, security, monitoring, or rollback changes (or write "not applicable").

- [ ] Relevant checks pass and regression tests cover behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, generated files, or unrelated changes are included.
